This genuinely depends on the story you're telling—neither is universally better. Early reveals build dread and dramatic irony (think Iago, or Hannibal Lecter); late reveals deliver a twist payoff but risk feeling cheap if the villain wasn't seeded fairly. If forced to pick one as the safer default for most novels, I'd say A, since sustained tension usually outlasts a single surprise.
